components.intent: Organize the surviving spatial sequence without asserting an exact ancient reconstruction.
Mark the negative-Z approach with sixteen columns in the observed 8/4/4 reading.
Provide the rectangular transition from pronaos to circular hall.
Preserve the circular interior and its measured diameter.
Complete the equal-diameter/equal-height interior volume with simplified coffer rings.
Represent the disputed oculus with a reversible diameter choice.
Maintain usable circulation from the approach into the rotunda.

constraint_responses.rationale: Keeps current evidence distinct from ancient reconstruction.
Uses an explicit reversible display scale.

proposal.label: Agent-selected readable shell
proposal.rationale: Preserves sequence, measured diameter-height relation, and legible wall thickness while simplifying ornament.
proposal.typology_hypothesis: Current-surviving portico, vestibule, rotunda, dome, and oculus sequence.
